question.text: The velocity components of an object traveling in the xy-plane depend on time according to vₓ = 8t − 2 and v_y = 2. At time t = 2 s, the object is located at the position x = 14 and y = 4. Which of the following expressions represents the equation of its trajectory?
conditions: at t = 2 s, x = 14 and y = 4

solution.approach: Integrate both velocity components with constants of integration, fix the constants from the given point, then eliminate time between x(t) and y(t).

steps.text: Integrate the two velocity components to get position, with constants of integration.
Use the given point x = 14, y = 4 at t = 2 s to find the constants.
Write x(t) and y(t) explicitly and solve y(t) for t.
Substitute t = y/2 into x(t) to eliminate time and get the path equation.

common_mistakes.text: Forgetting to solve for the constants of integration (taking C₁ = C₂ = 0) gives x = y² − y, which matches none of the printed algebraic options.
